_note: Illustrative SEP-2640 skills/get entry for this skill. Digests are unsigned and same-origin — per the spec they confirm consistency, not trust. With 'resources: dynamic' the entry still exposes the URI, frontmatter, and the dynamic marker, but provides no stable body or digest to pin — so a scanner can see the skill exists and is dynamic, yet cannot verify or reproduce what resources/read will return at execution. Inert illustration.
